name: Better Entity Reference
description: Entity reference, options, file, image and media widgets that show selections as tags or thumbnail tiles with a search/upload/browse popover, plus a matching Better Tags formatter.
project_description: Better Entity Reference replaces Drupal's default field widgets for entity reference, list (options), media, file and image fields with a tag- and tile-based interface. Selected items show as removable, reorderable tags or thumbnail tiles; a round "+" opens a popover to search, sort, filter, browse folders, upload and pick. It ships five widgets (Better Entity Reference, Better Options, Better Media, Better File, Better Image), a Better Tags formatter for both entity-reference and list fields, and two reusable Drupal form elements (better_entity_reference, better_options) for custom forms. The reference widgets store their value through core's own input so they fall back to the standard autocomplete without JavaScript. File/image/media uploads are chunked through the module's own endpoints, honoring the field's own validators and destination, and every endpoint is guarded by a session CSRF token plus a field-bound HMAC and per-result access filtering. Depends only on Drupal core (media, image, file and taxonomy features engage only when those modules and field types are present).
